name: FluentBit Connector - Workload Identity Federation Support
description: Fluent Bit is an open-source agent that collects logs, metrics, and traces from various sources. It allows you to filter, modify, and aggregate event data before sending it to storage. A workload identity is an identity you assign to a software workload (such as an application, service, script, or container) to authenticate and access other services and resources.This feature will enable the use Workload Identity for FluentBit connector to Fabric Real-Time Inellignece Eventhouse.Learn more: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/real-time-intelligence/get-data-fluent?tabs=default%2Cclassic
